user.title: NMA Mobile Credentials
user.description:
Connect to the NMA API. Use the development URL while testing.

Choose whether personal information comes into Home Assistant. Unticked, you get the overall health of the NMA API plus people and credential counts, without names or e-mail addresses.

data_description.base_url: https:// is added when you leave it out. Type http:// yourself for a plain-HTTP endpoint.
data_description.personal_data: Adds names and e-mail addresses (member lists on the count sensors), per-person and per-credential entities, and company contacts. Leave unticked for health and counts only.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the NMA API.
error.company_not_found: No company with that ID exists at this endpoint (404).
error.rate_limited: Rate limit hit (429). The API allows 30 requests/minute across all endpoints — wait a minute and try again.
error.server_unavailable: The API gateway returned 502/503/504. The backend is unreachable or temporarily down — check the URL and that the API is up.
error.invalid_url: Base URL must start with http:// or https://, or leave the scheme out to use https://.
error.invalid_company_id: Company ID must be a valid UUID.

abort.already_configured: This (base URL, company ID) is already configured.

init.title: NMA options
init.description: Untick personal information for health and counts only: no names, e-mail addresses or company contacts. The fetch toggles turn the people and credential counts on or off.

data_description.personal_data: Unticked = health and counts only. Per-person and per-credential entities are removed.

refresh.name: Refresh NMA data
refresh.description: Force-refresh one or all NMA config entries.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional NMA config entry ID. If omitted, every NMA entry is refreshed.
